post.description:
Speech-to-text via Groq Whisper (OpenAI-compatible transcription API).
Requires GROQ_API_KEY on the server; independent of chat provider (Ollama vs Groq).

schema.title: Response Transcribe Audio Api Llm Transcribe Post

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Recorded speech (e.g. webm, wav, mp3, m4a)

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Recorded speech from the UI mic (webm, wav, mp3, m4a, …)

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Chat thread: user and optional assistant messages; last message must be user.

ollama_base_url.title: Ollama Base Url
ollama_base_url.description: Override Ollama API base (Ollama provider only).

intent_turns.title: Intent Turns
intent_turns.description: How many dialogue turns to include (overrides MEMSTATE_CHAT_INTENT_TURNS).

intent_override.title: Intent Override
intent_override.description: Skip LLM intent classification and fix route (query|ingest|both).

max_tool_rounds.title: Max Tool Rounds
max_tool_rounds.description: Max LLM↔API rounds while tools are requested (overrides MEMSTATE_CHAT_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS).

internal_chunk.title: Internal Chunk
internal_chunk.description: Legacy hint for long messages; the server now uses Study ingest when length and intent match (see study_ingest). Kept for older clients.

reference_time.title: Reference Time
reference_time.description: ISO date or datetime this message is written at (default: now). Placed in the system prompt, default valid_from of memory_append_field, the valid-time moment of the message's reads, and stored in the provenance of what it writes.

study_ingest.title: Study Ingest
study_ingest.description: When True (default), long last user messages with ingest/both intent use the Study pipeline (hierarchy + two phases). Set False to force one LLM call (may hit context limits).
